title: CleanGutters Lighting vs PJ Fitz: 2026 Gutter Comparison
body_markdown:
CleanGutters Lighting and PJ Fitz both work gutters in the South Jersey market, but they're not built for the same homeowner. **Choose CleanGutters Lighting if you want permanent micro-mesh gutter protection installed by the same person every time, plus the option to add roofline LED lighting in one relationship.** **Choose PJ Fitz if you're looking for a general local contractor to handle routine gutter cleaning or repair without a specialty micro-mesh system attached.** The real split in this cleangutterslighting vs pj fitz comparison is specialist versus generalist, not "who's cheaper."


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins on gutter guard technology with stainless steel micro-mesh and a transferable lifetime warranty.
- Owner Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally — no subcontractors, since 2009.
- PJ Fitz functions as a general contractor for gutter cleaning and repair in the South Jersey region.
- Neither company publishes pricing online in 2026, so get a written quote from both before deciding.
- CleanGutters Lighting is the only option here offering permanent architectural roofline lighting.




## Why This Comparison Matters

Homeowners searching "cleangutterslighting vs pj fitz" are usually staring at a clogged gutter, a quote from one company, and a question about whether the other one does it better or cheaper. Both companies show up in South Jersey gutter searches, but they solve different problems.

CleanGutters Lighting has built its business around one core product — [surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) — plus a companion service most gutter companies don't touch: permanent exterior roofline LED lighting. PJ Fitz operates as a broader local contractor that includes gutter cleaning and repair among its offerings.

That difference in focus is the whole story. A specialist tends to go deeper on one system; a generalist tends to bundle more trades under one call. Neither model is automatically better — it depends on what you're solving for in 2026.

|---|---|---|
| Best for | Permanent micro-mesh protection + roofline lighting | General gutter cleaning and repair from a local contractor |

| Roofline LED lighting | Yes, custom architectural installs | Not part of the core gutter lineup |

## CleanGutters Lighting Offers More Gutter Guard Technology

Micro-mesh is the headline difference. CleanGutters Lighting's surgical stainless steel mesh is rated to handle 22+ inches of rain per hour without overflow, which is the kind of spec that matters during a real South Jersey downpour, not a light drizzle.

PJ Fitz's gutter services fall under a general home-services umbrella, and its guard specifications aren't published in enough detail to compare mesh size or material against a micro-mesh system. **If gutter guard technology is the deciding factor, CleanGutters Lighting has the documented edge.**

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Installation Accountability

CleanGutters Lighting's install model is simple: Alex installs every job personally, not a subcontracted crew. That matters for gutter guard work specifically, because a poor mesh seat or an unsealed edge is what causes the callbacks homeowners complain about years later.

PJ Fitz doesn't publish who performs each installation, so it's worth asking directly before signing anything. **On owner-level accountability, CleanGutters Lighting is the clearer choice as of 2026.**

## CleanGutters Lighting Is the Only One Offering Roofline LED Lighting

This one isn't close, because it's not really a competition — it's a service PJ Fitz doesn't appear to offer at all. CleanGutters Lighting installs custom architectural roofline LED lighting alongside gutter work, letting one company handle both the functional and cosmetic exterior upgrade.

If permanent roofline lighting is on your list for 2026, that narrows this comparison fast. **CleanGutters Lighting covers it; PJ Fitz's core lineup doesn't.**

## Both Handle Basic Gutter Cleaning

Here's an honest tie: routine gutter cleaning and minor repair work is something both companies do. If all you need is a seasonal cleanout with no guard system attached, either company can likely handle that call.

The difference shows up after the cleaning, not during it — one company is trying to sell you a permanent fix, the other may simply be trying to close out the service ticket. **For plain gutter cleaning with no guard upsell, this dimension is a wash.**

## CleanGutters Lighting Offers the Stronger Warranty Position

A transferable lifetime warranty on micro-mesh is a meaningful selling point, especially if you plan to sell the house before the gutters ever need touching again. That warranty transfers to the next owner, which is a detail buyers notice during inspection.

PJ Fitz's warranty terms for gutter work aren't published in enough detail to compare directly — ask for the written terms before you commit. **On warranty transparency, CleanGutters Lighting has the documented advantage.**

## PJ Fitz May Win on Convenience If You Already Use Them

This is the honest counterpoint. If PJ Fitz already handles other work at your home and gutters are a small add-on to an existing relationship, that one-stop convenience has real value — fewer trucks in the driveway, one invoice, one contact.

That convenience doesn't replace a micro-mesh system's engineering, but it's a legitimate reason some homeowners stick with a generalist. **If you value bundling over specialization, that's PJ Fitz's lane.**

## Pricing: Two Different Models, Not Two Different Numbers

Neither company publishes fixed pricing for 2026, so this isn't a numbers fight — it's a model fight. CleanGutters Lighting's micro-mesh system is a one-time installation investment backed by a transferable lifetime warranty, which trades a higher upfront cost for fewer repeat service calls.

A generalist gutter-cleaning model, the kind PJ Fitz's core offering resembles, typically trades a lower per-visit cost for recurring cleanings on a seasonal schedule. Get a written quote from both before deciding which trade-off fits your budget in 2026 — predictable long-term cost versus lower recurring cost.

PJ Fitz's published gutter services center on cleaning and repair rather than a named micro-mesh system. Confirm current guard options directly with PJ Fitz before comparing.

CleanGutters Lighting states that owner Alex installs every job personally, with no subcontractors. PJ Fitz doesn't publicly detail its crew assignment model.

**Does PJ Fitz offer permanent roofline lighting?**

Permanent architectural roofline LED lighting isn't part of PJ Fitz's core gutter service lineup. CleanGutters Lighting offers custom roofline lighting installs alongside its gutter guard work.

Gutter cleaning removes existing debris on a recurring schedule, while gutter guard installation, like CleanGutters Lighting's micro-mesh system, is a one-time install meant to reduce how often cleaning is needed by 40-60% based on reported results.

If you're planning to sell within the next decade, that single clause can outweigh a lower upfront quote from a generalist.
